contacts.notes: Founded Gordian Capital in 2005; led its DFSA/DIFC launch (licensed 23-Apr-2026). Now at IQ-EQ (acquired Gordian July 2025) leading Asia/Middle East fund-platform business. No email or phone published for him or the DIFC entity found in this research — do not guess one.

contacts.title: Founder, Gordian Capital; Managing Director & Head of Fund Platform and Solutions, Asia and Middle East, IQ-EQ

description: APAC's first and largest institutional cross-border fund platform and fund-solutions provider (est. 2005, acquired by IQ-EQ July 2025); DFSA-licensed 23-Apr-2026 to open a seventh global office in DIFC after Singapore, Tokyo, Hong Kong, Shanghai and Melbourne. Licensed for Managing a Collective Investment Fund, Advising on Financial Products, Arranging Custody, Arranging Deals in Investments and Managing Assets, with a 'Use a Fund Platform' endorsement. Runs ~USD 22bn across 115+ launched funds (hedge, PE, VC, real estate, private credit) since 2005 as an outsourced AIFM/fund-hosting platform for third-party managers.

fit.reasoning: Fit 55/60: priority segment fund manager (20) + priority market UAE (15) + genuinely multi-asset across hedge/PE/VC/real-estate/private-credit strategies for many underlying clients (10) + manages third-party money by design as a fund platform (10) + DFSA-regulated (5) — wealth & asset management sub-segment fit is very strong given fund administration/NAV/multi-strategy need. Timing 20/25: brand-new DFSA licence (23-Apr-2026), a hard new-entity trigger, no incumbent system yet in DIFC. Access 8/15: named decision-maker identified (Mark Voumard, Gordian founder and Head of Fund Platform & Solutions, Asia & Middle East at IQ-EQ, LinkedIn verified) but no warm relationship and no published email/phone for the DIFC entity yet, so 8 not 15. Total 85 — work it now.
